debate.key_bull_argument: EMA golden cross and three white soldiers provide technical confirmation of uptrend initiation in extreme fear environment (32/100 fear-greed), offering contrarian entry opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought stochastic/Williams %R, weak trend confirmation (ADX false), absent volume support (0.76 ratio), zero fundamental conviction, VIX crisis (419.2), and earnings risk in 60 days create a high-probability pullback setup that negates technical strength.
